854771076/CryptoFlash.body:
# CryptoFlash - Web3 News Push System

## 🌟 Project Introduction

CryptoFlash is a Web3 news push system based on the adapter pattern. It automatically crawls cryptocurrency-related news and pushes it to users in real time through multiple notification channels. The system uses a modular design and supports flexible extension of crawler sources and notification sources, achieving the design goal of "adding new sources without modifying core code".

## ✨ Features

- 🕷️ **Multi-source crawling**: Supports multiple news sources, including Binance exchange announcements and FORESIGHTNEWS
- 📢 **Multi-channel notifications**: Supports multiple notification methods, including DingTalk bots and email
- 📊 **Data deduplication**: Incremental data storage based on SQLite prevents duplicate pushes
- 🎨 **Markdown format**: Supports Markdown-formatted notification content for a better reading experience
- 🔧 **Flexible extension**: Uses the adapter pattern, so adding a new crawler or notification channel only requires implementing the interface
- 📦 **Lightweight deployment**: Supports local deployment and GitHub Actions automated deployment
- 📝 **Detailed logging**: Complete log records for troubleshooting and system monitoring

## 🛠️ Technical Architecture

### Tech Stack

| Technology/Library | Version | Purpose |
|---------|------|------|
| Python | 3.8+ | Programming language |
| requests | 2.31.0 | Network requests |
| curl_cffi | 0.9.0 | Network requests that bypass anti-scraping measures |
| fake_useragent | 1.5.1 | Generates random User-Agents |
| pyyaml | 6.0.1 | YAML configuration parsing |
| six | 1.17.0 | Python version compatibility utility |
| urllib3 | 1.25.11 | HTTP client library |

```mermaid

    A[main.py entry point]

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

# Chimera

> The next-generation host network manager: making network management simpler and more reliable, and running in the background as unobtrusively as possible.

Simplified Chinese | [English](https://github.com/MFSGA/Chimera/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) | [Русский](https://github.com/MFSGA/Chimera/blob/HEAD/README.ru.md) | [فارسی](https://github.com/MFSGA/Chimera/blob/HEAD/README.fa.md)

> **Chimera Proxy** — Rust-native desktop client for the Chimera proxy ecosystem.

## Chimera Ecosystem

```text
Chimera Desktop
       ↕
Chimera Client (Rust client core)
       ↕ VLESS / REALITY
Chimera Proxy Server (Rust server core)
       ↕
AChimera · Proxy Wiki
```

- [Chimera Client](https://github.com/MFSGA/Chimera_Client) — Rust client core with Clash / Mihomo compatibility
- [Chimera Proxy Server](https://github.com/MFSGA/Chimera_Service) — Pure Rust Xray-compatible server core
- [AChimera](https://github.com/MFSGA/AChimera) — Android client
- [Proxy Wiki](https://mfsga.github.io/Proxy_WIKI/) — documentation and deployment notes

---

## Project Introduction

Chimera aims to be the next-generation, most user-friendly host network manager. On Windows, macOS, and Linux/NixOS, it integrates proxy cores, system network settings, and day-to-day connection management so that networking works stably and reliably, running in the background as unobtrusively as possible. The project is built with Tauri, Rust, and React, and it also keeps clear status, logs, and control entry points so users can understand and control what is happening when they need to.

chinjiaqing/jc-daily-report.description: Daily Jingcai football match analysis and football betting line interpretation; sports lottery
chinjiaqing/jc-daily-report.body:
# ⚽ Football Signal Radar · Daily Signal Report

> **Set emotions aside and watch only the signals.**
> Cross-validation of line movements across three channels. No bets on low odds; no entry when signals are unclear. Execution is automatic before matches, and settlement is automatic after.

## 🚀 Online Site

- **[https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/](https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/)**
- Updated automatically every hour, with historical dates archived for review at any time
- Covers **500–1300+** matches per day (full Jingcai/Asian handicap coverage), with signals and bets automatically flagged

---

## The Detours We Bypassed

We tried **models**: we piled up parameters until the room was full. Looking back, the model merely recited the prices the market had already set, and more parameters could not produce anything new.

We tried **studying the market makers**: guessing at the bookmakers' moves, we guessed more and more, until it looked like paranoid delusion. Eventually we realized that guessing at the bookmaker is less useful than watching the price.

We also tried **AI predictions**: injuries, team motivation, form. Each one sounded convincing, and each had long been priced into the odds. No matter how lively the story, the line does not accept it.

After the detours, one plain truth remains:

> **Money shows where it is going, and the line speaks.**
> But people watching the line get carried away easily: chasing favorites, fearing underdogs, and getting shaky-handed at the last minute. Anyone can see that emotion is doing the trading.

So we hand both 'watching' and 'buying' to a machine, and leave people with only one thing: **discipline**.

## Three Informants, One Referee

**1X2 odds** track market-wide odds movements: who is being collectively abandoned, who is quietly defending their position, and whether the draw line has been given up. This is the informant closest to the action.

**Asian handicap** tracks lines and water levels. Sudden last-minute pivots and money backing the upper side show real cash being thrown in, which is more reliable than what people say.

**Over/Under** tracks the total goals line. When a breeding ground for goals appears, the number of goals in that match has often already been signaled.

Each of the three informants has its own information. When the information agrees, the referee is willing to make a call. **Matches where the informants disagree (1X2 and Asian handicap conflicting) are not touched at all.** If the informants are already arguing with each other, why would you place a bet?

## Discipline Matters More Than Vision

Once the direction is set, everything else is discipline:

- **No bets on low odds**: single-selection odds below 1.5, or double-selection odds discounted below 1.3, will not be bought regardless of how good the signal is. At that level, even a win does not make much money.
- **No entry without a clear signal**: no signal, conflicting signals, or vague direction means waiting. Missing a bet costs nothing; a bad bet loses money.
- **Quality determines stake size**: the stronger the signal, the larger the stake (1/2/4 units). No all-in gambling.
- **Bets are placed automatically 15 minutes before kickoff, and results are settled automatically when they come in**: no last-minute shakiness, and no urge to raise stakes after a win or chase losses after a defeat.

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

This project is for data research only and does not constitute any betting advice. Buy lottery tickets only at offline physical retail outlets. Persons under 18 years of age are not permitted to participate.

hloolx/codpl.body:
# CODPL

CODPL is a static evaluation site for multi-vendor Coding Plan / Code API, used for Coding Plan evaluation, Coding Plan speed testing, Code API benchmarking, multi-vendor model comparison, and long-term trend tracking. The project continuously displays TTFT, MedianTPS, composite experience scores, and historical snapshots across different platforms and models, helping developers review real probe results before onboarding, purchasing, and selection.

If you are searching for any of the following, this project is for you:

- Coding Plan evaluation
- Coding Plan benchmark
- Coding Plan speed test
- Coding Plan vendor comparison
- Coding Plan purchase reference
- Code API response speed comparison
- TTFT / MedianTPS / composite experience ranking

## Online Access

- Main site: <https://codpl.15o.cc>
- Overseas node: <https://bench.codpl.com/>
- Vendor onboarding status, purchase links, official documentation entry: <https://bench.codpl.com/providers>

The overseas node is served by Cloudflare, suitable for access from overseas networks.

## What the Project Does

- Continuously probes multiple Coding Plan / Code API vendors and publicly displays the most recent round of results.
- Compares time to first token (TTFT), MedianTPS, composite scores, and performance of the same model across vendors.
- Accumulates historical data through static JSON snapshots, making it easy to observe 24-hour and 30-day trend changes.
- Provides developers, team purchasing, and model selection with a public, intuitive, and verifiable reference page.

This repository is the front-end release repository; it only keeps the front-end code and snapshot data needed by the static site, and does not include backend source code, databases, or private environment variables.

## Vendors Currently Covered by Benchmarks

The public page currently covers the following Coding Plan / Code API vendors; for the full model list see [BENCHMARK_COVERAGE.md](https://github.com/hloolx/codpl/blob/HEAD/BENCHMARK_COVERAGE.md):

## Feature Overview

| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Workspace | Create, read, update, and delete on the left; right-click menu (Settings / Edit / Delete); the workspace settings page can configure prompts / skills / MCP; cwd = workspace path |
| Draft / Todo | “New draft” only saves to the database; “New Todo” creates the task and starts running it; drag between swimlanes to change status |
| In Progress / Completed / Archived | SSE live-refreshes cards and logs; processes can be stopped; completed cards can be archived |
| Continue task | Tasks in a terminal state can be resumed using the CLI session, with the iteration count +1 |
| Webhook | `POST /api/hooks/tasks` (requires `AGENT_BOARD_WEBHOOK_SECRET`) |
| Storage | Postgres (`DATABASE_URL`) |

For more design details, see [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/mengfei0053/agent-board/blob/HEAD/ARCHITECTURE.md). For the HTTP API, see [/docs](http://127.0.0.1:8791/docs) on a running instance.

## Requirements

- Node 20+ (local development) or Docker / Docker Compose (one-command startup)
- The following must be findable in the local PATH: `pi`, `claude`, `agent`, `devin`, `codex` (depending on the agents you actually use; see “Docker and CLI” below)
- Postgres (local or built into Compose)

## One-Command Startup (Docker Compose)

```bash
cd ~/projects/agent-board   # or your clone path
cp -n .env.example .env
# Required: replace POSTGRES_PASSWORD with a random, URL-safe, long password, and update DATABASE_URL to match.
# The placeholder replace-with-a-long-random-password is not a strong password. For an existing volume, ALTER…
```

molimao/iota.body:
# IOTA Watch

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem; each project's inputs, cycles, and data coverage are described separately.

**[Official site](https://iotahome.site) · [My Devices](https://iotahome.site/zh/devices) · [IOTA Lookup](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) · [Network Status](https://iotahome.site/zh/network) · [Blog](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog) · [English](https://iotahome.site/en)**

IOTA Watch is an independent MIT-licensed monitor in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.

The screenshot shows miner distribution and network capacity; the figures are official data as of when the screenshot was taken.

## Features

- **Multi-device monitoring**: add, name, and view devices by public Miner ID, filtering by contributing, waiting for tasks, needs checking, and pending confirmation.
- **Earnings records**: today, cumulative, paid, pending payment, frozen, and minimum payment amounts; also shows USD valuations with source and timestamp.
- **Training history**: view training tokens, throughput, and cumulative tokens by day, week, or month; missing data is left as gaps.
- **Network visualization**: regional distribution donut chart, miner count rankings, slot occupancy, task progress, and tier overview.

# Proxy List

## Project Introduction

I found an online proxy webpage that's pretty interesting. Its proxies are updated quite quickly, so I scraped it. The proxies are almost all usable, not a 10,000-proxy list where only a handful actually work.

The webpage https://tomcat1235.nyc.mn/ has a fairly comprehensive collection. If you're interested, go scrape it yourself.

## Features

- ⚡ Automatically fetches the latest proxy list
- 🔄 Scheduled updates (runs once every hour)
- 📝 Standard format output: `protocol://ip:port [location]`
- 🌍 Includes geolocation information
- 📊 Supports multiple proxy protocols (HTTP, SOCKS5, etc.)

## Usage

### Manual Run

```bash
python generate_proxy_list.py
```

### Viewing Results

The proxy list is saved in the `proxy.txt` file, in the following format:

```
socks5://37.18.73.60:5566 [美国 加州 圣何塞]
http://123.143.162.221:6388 [韩国 首尔特别市]
socks5://35.183.59.99:5080 [加拿大 魁北克省 蒙特利尔]
```

## Automatic Updates

This project uses GitHub Actions for automated updates:

- 🕐 Runs automatically once every hour
- 📝 Automatically commits the updated proxy list
- 🔄 Keeps the proxy information up to date

## Dependencies

- requests
- beautifulsoup4

## Disclaimer

This project is for learning and research purposes only. Please comply with applicable laws and regulations and the terms of use of any websites you access.

# AzurPilot — Azur Lane Automation Assistant Tool

      

## Project Introduction

AzurPilot is an automation assistant tool for Azur Lane, modified from AzurLaneAutoScript. It retains the core capabilities of the original project and, on that basis, integrates several forks, feature improvements, and experimental features. It controls Android emulators via ADB/uiautomator2 and automatically executes game tasks using screenshot recognition, image matching, and OCR. It supports the CN/EN/JP/TW servers.

> **Please note**: The code of this project is largely generated and assisted by AI and carries considerable uncertainty. Pull requests to correct it are welcome: [Pull Request](https://github.com/wess09/AzurPilot/pulls).

Visit the **[AzurPilot website](https://azurpilot.com/)** for more feature details, or go to the **[download page](https://azurpilot.com/download.html)** to get the latest version.

## GUI Preview

## Quick Start

> 💡 **Recommended**: Download the launcher for your platform directly from the [AzurPilot website download page](https://azurpilot.com/download.html). It includes a built-in Python environment and works out of the box.

### Linux One-Click Deployment

```shell
curl -fsSL https://azurpilot.com/install/deploy-image.sh | sudo -E bash
```

### Running from Source

This project uses `uv` and the `.venv` directory in the project root to manage the Python runtime environment (requires Python >= 3.14). Release launchers come bundled with uv, Python, ADB, and Git, and sync dependencies into `.venv`. For source development, install uv and run:

```bash
uv sync --frozen --no-dev
uv run python gui.py
```

After startup, visit `http://127.0.0.1:25548` in a browser to open the WebUI.

## Important Notes

- This project contains a large amount of automation logic and image-recognition-related functionality. Before use, make sure you have completed the [in-game settings](#使用前设置); otherwise recognition may fail, workflows may behave abnormally, or tasks may not run correctly.
- This project includes some experimental features that may have unknown issues. It is recommended to back up the relevant configuration before use and to report any anomalies promptly.

## Pre-Use Settings

The in-game settings must be changed to the following standards before use.

Path: Main screen → Settings at bottom right → options in the left sidebar.

| Setting Name | Recommended Value |
| --- | --- |
| Frame rate setting | 60 FPS |
| Large operation settings, reduce TB guidance | On |
| Large operation settings, auto-submit items when auto-grinding | On |…

## Description

GitHub Actions automatically scrapes Weibo trending searches daily and archives them to [website](https://xiadd.github.io/tg-wb-trending/), and sends hot topic messages to the tg channel [微博实时热搜](https://t.me/weibo_hots) every hour

## Deployment

1. Create a bot on [BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather) and get the bot's token

2. Create a channel and set the bot as a channel administrator

3. Get the channel's id; you can use the [GetID](https://t.me/getidsbot) bot to get the channel id

4. Set TOKEN and CHANNEL_ID in the GitHub project settings

5. Change docs/public/CNAME to your own domain, and set GitHub Pages to the gh-pages branch

## Development

1. Use tg bogfather to create a bot
2. Create a new channel and set the bot as a channel administrator
3. Set TOKEN in the repository to the telegram bot's token
